facts.text: I am Mohammad Al Jubairy.
I am a Senior Graphic Designer / PMO.
My address is in Saudi Arabia, Al Riyadh.
My phone number is 59021 900 5 966+.
My email is jubairy@gmail.com.
My nationality is Palestinian.
I was born on 10 Jan 1984 in KSA.
My status is married.
I have over 14 years of experience in graphic design.
I am currently working with Parsons Corporation.
I worked at Parsons Corporation (SAPL) as a Graphic Designer / PMO from Jun 2020 to present.
I worked at the Royal Commission for Riyadh City (CRCR) as a Senior Graphic Designer / Team Leader from Feb 2014 to Apr 2020.
I worked at DESIGN PLUS as a Senior Graphic Designer from Jan 2011 to Feb 2014.
I worked at DESIGN PLUS as a Graphic Designer from Jan 2008 to Jan 2011.
I have a Bachelor Degree of Applied Arts in Advertisement from Sixth October University, Cairo, Egypt.
My Bachelor Degree of Applied Arts in Advertisement was from 2002 to 2007.

I have strong project management skills.
